import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 道侣日常任务 - 查看
 *
 * 指令：
 *   /道侣任务         → 查看任务列表
 *   /道侣任务 领取     → 提示已改为自动发放
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/companion/dailyTask/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const rawText = e.MessageText.trim();
  const match = rawText.match(/道侣任务\s*(.*)/);
  const args = match ? match[1].trim() : '';

  let result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof App>>;

  try {
    result = await App({ uid, bid, args });
  } catch {
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '道侣任务', content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('查看道侣任务失败，请稍后再试') }));

    return;
  }
  if (result.code === 'LOCKED') {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '道侣任务', realmName: result.data.realmName });

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'NO_COMPANION') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '道侣任务', content: md, footer: [{ label: '结缘', command: '/结为道侣' }] }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'AUTO_CLAIM_HINT') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '道侣任务',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '道侣任务', command: '/道侣任务' },
          { label: '我的道侣', command: '/我的道侣' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  for (const task of result.data.tasks) {
    const statusText = task.completedCount > 0 ? '已完成' : '未完成';
    const progressText = `${task.completedCount}/${task.dailyLimit}`;
    const earnedText = task.earnedTongxin > 0 ? `（已获得 ${task.earnedTongxin} 同心值）` : '';

    md.addText(`【${task.index}】${task.name}`);
    md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([`同心值：${task.rewardDesc}`, `进度：${progressText}`, `状态：${statusText}${earnedText}`]));
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '道侣日常任务',
      content: md,
      footer: [
        { label: '信息', command: '/我的道侣' },
        { label: '双修', command: '/双修' }
      ]
    })
  );
});
